metadata.title: Soft Glam Portrait with Scribbled Overlays

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, soft-focus portrait featuring monochromatic warm tones and spontaneous, hand-scribbled typographic overlays with highlighter accents.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist sans-serif typography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered beauty portrait of a woman with voluminous platinum blonde curls, characterized by a monochromatic pinkish-beige palette and informal, thin-nib handwritten text that appears to float across the upper third of the frame, occasionally highlighted with translucent yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic harmony between skin tones, hair, and background
Contrast between polished beauty photography and raw, messy handwriting
Symmetry of the facial features anchored by a hand touching the chin
High-key lighting that minimizes shadows and emphasizes soft textures
coreInvariants: Platinum blonde hair with high-volume curls

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered headshot filling 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the hand resting against the jawline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the centered gaze, move upward to the handwritten text, and follow the yellow highlights across the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners and around the hair periphery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale peach and beige (skin and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with a single high-saturation accent.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm neutrals and one neon accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair raw handwriting with a clean, high-end photographic subject to create a 'diary' or 'confessional' mood.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the thin, vertical nature of the script

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key beauty portrait of a woman with platinum blonde 1950s-style curls, soft peach skin tones, and a hand touching her face, against a light beige background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, black hand-scribbled text across the top of the hair. Apply a translucent neon yellow highlighter effect behind specific words.

verificationChecks: Is the text thin and scratchy?
Is the overall palette monochromatic warm?
Is the lighting soft with minimal shadows?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure handwriting is original and not a direct copy of the source text
postGenerationChecks: Verify the yellow highlight does not obscure the text legibility.
Ensure the hand position looks natural and not distorted.
Check that the hair texture remains soft and detailed.
Confirm the monochromatic beige/pink balance is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft Glam Portrait + [Subject Description] + Monochromatic [Color] Palette + [Handwritten Phrase] in Thin Ink + Yellow Highlighter Accents.
